Check after #1223 · iPad menu and larger Dynamic Type (backlog #1224)

Simulator iOS 27, iPhone 18 Pro and iPad Pro 11" (M5). Fixtures -macs 3 -activity YES -longWorkspace YES. Branch check/workspace-menu-rows. Shots: check/*-1224-*.jpg.

iPad · menu from the capsule

Names and subtitles stay on one line. The checkmark and the status glyph both fit. The long name is cut to "infra-terraform-s…" and fits. Dark and light look the same.

iPhone · Dynamic Type

SizeResult
Large (default)One line for every name and subtitle. Checkmark and glyph fit.
XXLThe menu keeps its width, so text wraps: "MacBook Pro" (2 lines), subtitles (2 lines), "infra-terraform-s…" (2 lines). Checkmark and glyph still fit. The menu scrolls: the workspace rows are below the fold.
AX3The system draws a full-width list without glyphs. Names and subtitles stay on one line, "infra-terraform-s…" fits. The checkmark stays; the status glyph is gone (system).

Ruling

No code change. At XXL even "MacBook Pro" (11 characters) wraps, so a limit that depends on the size would have to be about 8 characters to keep one line, and the Mac names and the subtitles would still wrap. At AX3 the system menu has room for the 17-character cut. 2 lines at XXL are an accepted limit of the system menu (written in design/features/workspace-picker/rules.md). Not shot: XL, XXXL, AX1, AX2, and a name of wide letters ("MMMM…"), which can take 2 lines at Large.
